subject.name_or_desc: A gentleman, a soldier (his name is withheld by Lilly)

context.question: (1) If he were like to live long, yea or no? (2) To what part of the world he were best to direct his course of life? (3) What part of his life was in probability like to be most fortunate? (4) What general accidents had happened unto him already? (5) What accidents in future he might expect, good or ill? (6) The time when?
context.asked_at: Not stated in the chapter (no dated figure heading is given in the text).
context.setting: He propounded six demands at once.

attachments.ascendant: Leo (sign ascending; a fixed star of the first magnitude, Cor Leonis/Regulus, in 24°34′ of Leo neer the cusp of the first house)
attachments.key_positions: The Sun, lord of the Ascendant, in Aries 4°18′ in the ninth house, in his exaltation, two degrees ten minutes distant from the cusp of the ninth; the Moon in Virgo in the second house applying to a trine of Jupiter; Jupiter and Venus in Taurus in the tenth house; Mars in the eighth house; the Moon wanting 7°22′ of the opposition of Mars
attachments.note: Positions as stated in Lilly's prose judgment; the OCR glyphs for the signs are corrupt and degrees are recorded only where the prose prints them numerically.
